**Structures: the game's villages, Ancient Cities, Trial Chambers and more, one click each**

The new Structure tool (Decor group) places the game's own structures where you click, on the map or in the 3D view: the five villages, a pillager outpost, the desert and jungle temples, a witch hut, an igloo, shipwrecks, ocean ruins, an Ancient City with its warden, Trial Chambers, a stronghold with its End portal, trail ruins and bastion remnants. Massif reads them from your own Minecraft (and your mods') and assembles them the way the game does, piece by piece: their chests keep their loot tables, spawners their mobs, villages their villagers, and the Ancient City's sculk shriekers summon the warden. Its outline follows the pointer before you click, villages and temples sit on flattened ground, an Ancient City is carved into the deep dark at y −52, and each placement is one step to undo; a right-click takes one away. `massif-cli structure` places them from the command line, and `tools/minecraft_check.py --structures` has the game itself confirm them.
